_views.text: ChronoVision is the time-travel diagnostic system of Luna. It listens to every message on the bus and records each state change as an immutable SystemEvent. The EventLog is never mutated — only appended. At any moment you can ask: what was the state of Artifact 115 at tick 47? ChronoVision replays the log in the exact Fixed Sacred Order and returns the reconstructed state. If a tick failed, it surfaces failedAt + templateId + reason — the same diagnostic as the live orchestrator. The log is organized as a fractal geometric tree, clustered by PHI ratio. A symmetry below 0.7 (the same threshold as CanResonate at 639 Hz) makes the error visible as a geometric asymmetry — detectable before the text is read. Time is not lost. Everything that happened is still there.
